name: Demo Hall (fictional)
disclaimer: FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. This map does not describe Davis Hall or any other real building. All distances, accessibility details and availability are simulated for demonstration only.

landmarks.name: North Plaza (outside)
landmarks.arrivalCue: Open paved area with a bike rack and benches.

landmarks.name: Main Entrance lobby
landmarks.arrivalCue: Small lobby between two sets of doors, with a floor mat underfoot.

landmarks.name: West junction, Floor 1
landmarks.arrivalCue: Corridors meet here; a drinking fountain hums against the wall.

landmarks.name: Stairwell A door, Floor 1
landmarks.arrivalCue: Heavy door with a push bar; the stairwell echoes when it opens.

landmarks.name: East junction, Floor 1
landmarks.arrivalCue: The main corridor ends at a cross corridor; recycling bins stand against the end wall.

landmarks.name: Elevator A lobby, Floor 1
landmarks.arrivalCue: Small lobby with a call button panel; you may hear the elevator chime.

landmarks.name: Room 105 (demo classroom)
landmarks.arrivalCue: Door with a raised-letter and braille sign reading 105.

landmarks.name: Stairwell A door, Floor 2
landmarks.arrivalCue: Stairwell door with the floor number in raised letters on the frame.

landmarks.name: Elevator A lobby, Floor 2
landmarks.arrivalCue: The elevator announces Floor 2 and opens onto a small lobby.

landmarks.name: Central junction, Floor 2
landmarks.arrivalCue: Wide carpeted area with a seating area to one side.

landmarks.name: Room 201 (demo lab)
landmarks.arrivalCue: Door with a raised-letter and braille sign reading 201.

landmarks.name: Annex reading room (via skybridge)
landmarks.arrivalCue: Quiet room just past the skybridge, where the floor changes from tile to carpet.

instructions.forward: Walk up the five front steps to the main entrance doors. There are handrails on both sides.
instructions.reverse: Go out through the main entrance doors and walk down the five front steps to the plaza.

instructions.forward: Follow the paved path beside the front steps to the ramp, then go up the ramp to the main entrance doors. The doors have a push-button opener.
instructions.reverse: Go out through the main entrance doors and follow the ramp down to the plaza.

instructions.forward: Go through the inner lobby doors and continue straight until the corridor meets a cross corridor.
instructions.reverse: Leave the junction toward the entrance and go through the inner lobby doors.

instructions.forward: Continue straight across the junction to the end of the short corridor, where the Stairwell A door is.
instructions.reverse: Leave the stairwell door and walk along the short corridor until it meets the cross corridor.

instructions.forward: Take the long main corridor lined with bulletin boards and follow it until it ends at the next junction.
instructions.reverse: Take the long main corridor lined with bulletin boards and follow it until you reach the junction with the drinking fountain.

instructions.forward: From the junction, take the corridor that leads to the Elevator A lobby.
instructions.reverse: Leave the elevator lobby along its corridor until you reach the junction with the recycling bins.

instructions.forward: From the junction, take the short side corridor to the second door, which is Room 105.
instructions.reverse: Leave Room 105 and follow the short side corridor back to the junction.

verification.notes: Exit-only door: cannot be opened from outside, so it is one-way.

instructions.forward: Push through the east exit door at the end of the cross corridor, then follow the outside path around the building back to the plaza.
Go up the stairs to Floor 2: two flights with a landing between them, handrails on both sides. Leave through the Floor 2 door.
instructions.reverse: Go down the stairs to Floor 1: two flights with a landing between them, handrails on both sides. Leave through the Floor 1 door.

instructions.forward: Press the call button, enter Elevator A and select Floor 2. Wait for the Floor 2 announcement before leaving.
instructions.reverse: Press the call button, enter Elevator A and select Floor 1. Wait for the Floor 1 announcement before leaving.

instructions.forward: Leave the stairwell and follow the corridor until it opens into the wide carpeted area.
instructions.reverse: From the carpeted area, take the corridor that leads to the Stairwell A door.

instructions.forward: Leave the elevator lobby and follow the corridor until it opens into the wide carpeted area.
instructions.reverse: From the carpeted area, take the corridor that leads to the Elevator A lobby.

instructions.forward: Cross the carpeted area to the door on the far side of the seating area. That door is Room 201.
instructions.reverse: Leave Room 201 into the wide carpeted area.

verification.notes: Deliberately left unknown to demonstrate that unknown is never treated as step-free.

instructions.forward: Follow the glass-walled skybridge to its end, then go through the doors into the Annex reading room.
instructions.reverse: Leave the reading room through the skybridge doors and follow the skybridge back to the carpeted area.
